name: Jaguar Land Rover
sub: The I-PACE: Waymo's first scaled robotaxi workhorse
regions: Global; AV platform role primarily US through Waymo
leadership: Adrian Mardell; Tata Motors parent leadership to verify
about: Automaker whose Jaguar I-PACE became Waymo's main commercial robotaxi platform during the first scaled phase.
model: Vehicle sales and fleet supply; part of Tata Motors group.
deployment: Jaguar I-PACE robotaxis operating in Waymo service markets; later being supplemented by Zeekr and Hyundai platforms.
metrics: Waymo planned over 2,000 additional I-PACE vehicles through their Magna-supported Mesa integration program.
signal: I-PACE remains the clearest proof point that an existing premium EV platform can support scaled L4 ridehail.
